_comment: The seller's limits (numbers, enforced by code in secondlook/guard.py) and preferences (words, followed by the judge in every reply).
seller_preferences: Never ask buyers to measure an item: a measurement a buyer reports cannot be verified. Ask for checkable proof instead, such as a photo of the size label.
For fit complaints on items sent in the size ordered, offer an exchange as goodwill, without conditions.
When the buyer's right is uncertain, hold your position: offer no refund, ask for proof that can be checked, and leave the decision to PayPal if the buyer escalates.
